🐾 LSeT – Animal Care Skill Development Initiative

LSeT is a dedicated animal care skill development training initiative focused on 🐶 animal care, 🏥 management, 🔬 research, and innovation. We offer elaborate training programs designed to build real-world skills with practical applications.

Our advanced research-based, hands-on training programs provide a realistic learning experience that prepares and encourages trainees to build a successful animal care career✨
